name: Classic Gorilla G
bio: Big chain, bigger arms. Peels bananas and enemies the same way.
notes: Retired to MapMaker 2026-11-25 (owner: "All replacements can be retired to the mapmaker for use in other creations such as scenarios"): the model Gorilla G (`core.gorillag`) wore until the owner's new model of 2026-11-25 took that id, name and place. Its built files kept under this id; `use: figure`: off Character Select, bots, random picks and Roulette; MapMaker places it as a Figure (docs/CHARACTERS.md, "Retired to MapMaker"). Was: Drive intake of 2026-11-13 ("Gorilla G Style T Pose", as Meshy names the download; rigged and animated on Meshy: Mixamo joint names read as Meshy's; its clips are not used, the hands are fitted by hands.mjs). Core since 2026-11-14 (the owner, after looking at the twelve of 2026-11-13: promote all twelve). Name and bio are ours (the name suggested by the owner's session, 2026-11-14; the owner can rename it). Licence: Meshy Community, CC0 per the owner (CLAUDE.md, Content rules: Meshy models the owner shares are Meshy Community CC0 unless the owner says they made them). Grip (owner, 2026-11-14: fix the rifle support hand): its long arms left the support hand short of the handguard, at the magazine; the gun held 15 cm nearer (`hold.forward`), the support point 10 cm along the guard, the shooting palm onto the grip, and its fingers re-fitted from the mesh (`fingers: fit`: its own finger joints curled the hands away from the grip).
